title: Implementation complexity category
story: As a user, I want an Implementation Complexity score so I can judge how hard a scenario is to deliver.
description: Score Implementation Complexity from delivery-difficulty signals (implementation quality, optimism penalty, lever aggressiveness). Political acceptability is NOT scored; it is expressed via configurable weighting profiles (US-007), per the vision's neutrality principle.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation Complexity computed deterministically from implementation quality, optimism penalty and lever aggressiveness
Plain-English rationale provided for the score
No political or ideological acceptability is scored as a fixed category
